text:
maya: quick PSA — trying to onboard redwood-judge-xl-q4 (quantized) into the eval harness. seeing weird tie outcomes on a small chat benchmark

devon: can you paste the run summary?

maya: here's the short run output from eval-bot:
```
eval-bot: run 1938456789
model: redwood-judge-xl-q4
agreement: 0.82
consensus_kappa: 0.47
tie_rate: 0.11
calibration_bias_en-in: 0.08
```

sam: tie_rate 11% seems high vs baseline ~4%. did quantization reorder logits or flip top choices?

leo: ran a tiny repro — found a suspicious chunk in eval-runner tie_breaker logic. might be a bug computing top2 margin.

ria: which file/line? link plz. @maya can you post stack?

devon: snippet from local clone (simplified):
```
# buggy
margin = max(preds) - min(preds)
if margin < 0.0:
    margin = abs(margin)
```

sam: that looks wrong — margin should be top1 - top2, not top1 - min. min can be far from second-best. also margin is never < 0.

maya: yep. confirmed with a trace: when two candidates are close, the code computes an inflated margin and downstream logic thinks there's no tie. when preds are equal-ish it sometimes returns identical scores and fallback becomes random.

eval-bot: auto note: new metric 'agreement_wt' (inter_annotator_agreement_weighted) is computed by runner but not exported to CI/gating pipeline. dashboard link: https://dash.internal/eval/1938456789

leo: CI gating currently only checks 'agreement' and 'kappa' — we never wired agreement_wt into the policy. that's critical for judge-weighted decisions.

ria: ops-bot: can we add agreement_wt to the gating rules and ensure it's present in schema?

ops-bot: queued patch: CI schema update + gate rule proposal. tagging @ci-team. ETA ~30m.

devon: propose remediation steps: 1) fix top2 margin code, 2) add agreement_wt to CI export/schema, 3) add deterministic tie-breaker: calibration score -> lower entropy -> human fallback.

sam: question: is calibration score trustworthy for Q4 judges? quantization can alter logits scale and thus calibration. we should run a quantization calibration sweep.

maya: agreed. quick command to reproduce scan:
```
./eval_runner --model redwood-judge-xl-q4 --suite judge-general --bias-probe dialects --quant-scan --output /tmp/qt-scan.json
```

leo: and add metric: `flip_rate_after_quant` — fraction of pairwise A/B comparisons where ordering changes vs fp16 baseline.

ria: also we should run dialect-level bias checks again. en-in + en-uk were borderline on some caste/dialect prompts in small sample.

maya: pasted a short example where the judge gave different verdicts when phrasing changed (slightly paraphrased) — looks like calibration shift after quantization.

sam: ensemble idea: run fp16 + q4 judges and use weighted majority (weights = calibration reliability). reduces single-model quantization brittleness.

devon: tactical plan: hotfix runner (top2), add agreement_wt to CI export, run full harness overnight with fp16 / q4 / ensemble; if metrics within thresholds, canary to internal dedicated cluster.

eval-bot: CI job 1938456793 failed: KeyError: 'agreement_wt' at eval-gate/schema.py:42 — failing early.

ops-bot: I've opened PR to add 'agreement_wt' to schema and gate; PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/eval-ci/pulls/742 (small).

maya: thanks — once CI schema patch merges, rerun quick patch branch with runner fix. can we do a 20-min sync in 30?

leo: +1 for 30. I'll sketch quick checklist:
- fix top2 code + unit test (edge tie case)
- add agreement_wt export + CI schema update
- add flip_rate_after_quant metric to reports
- schedule overnight full-run (fp16, q4, ensemble)
- dialect bias subset checks and sample dump for SME review

ria: assigning followups: leo -> runner fix, ops-bot -> CI schema, sam -> quant sweep config, maya -> bias sample curation + huddle invite.

devon: great. small note: update eval docs about tie-break priority order (majority -> calibration -> entropy -> human). add as a gating comment so we don't regress.

maya: copy. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sam: will run quick repro after runner fix and ping results in thread.

(eval-bot automated): run artifacts uploaded to https://artifacts.internal/eval/1938456789/ (logs + samples)

ops-bot: CI schema patch merged to main. re-run queued jobs.

leo: patched runner in branch fix/top2-margin, added unit tests. pushing now.

maya: meeting invite sent for in 30.

sam: on it. will report back with flip_rate numbers after the sweep.

devon: closing loop here — please paste any high-confidence diffs to the dashboard when available so PM and compliance teams can review.
